newsitem.title: USA: Fore Systems rescinds stock buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: Fore Systems rescinds stock buyback plan.

text.p: Fore Systems Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors rescinded the company's share buyback program due to uncertainty over U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission interpretation of some accounting rules.
In July, the company was authorized to repurchase up to two million of its common shares to fund a stock option plan. It said 120,000 have been repurchased so far under the plan.

But recent SEC statements made the company uncertain it could maintain its repurchase program and remain eligible to use the pooling of interest method when accounting for business combinations, it said.
In its last fiscal year, FORE said it completed four acquisitions which were accounted for as pooling of interests.
FORE designs, develops, makes and sells high-performance networking products based on asynchronous transfer mode technology.
